IS 15550 : 2005 Failure Mode Effects AnalysisICS 03.120.30MSD 3Reaffirmed 20201 Scope1.1 This standard describes potential Failure Mode and Effects Analysis(FMEA) and provides generic guidelines in the application of thetechnique. There are four basic types of FMEA, namely:a) Design FMEA,b) Process FMEA,c) Programme/Project FMEA, andd) Machinery FMEA.1.2 Process FMEA is of two types:a) Manufacturing FMEA, andb) Assembly FMEA.The Machinery and Programme FMEA are not covered by this standard. FMEAincludes all requirements of FMECA as well. The typical Design FMEA andProcess FMEA Quality objectives are listed in Annex A and Annex B.2 ReferencesIS 11137 : Part 2 : 1984Analysis technique for system reliability: Part 2 Procedures for failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) and failure mode effects and criticality analysis (FMECA)IS 10645 : 2003Methods of estimation of process capability and process performanceIS 15280 : 2002Quality function deployment
